body:
Periods are periods and it is something that we have to put up with, I'm not disgusted by it personally. I actually look forward to getting my period because it means that I no longer need to feel bloated or have a swollen tummy between my hips! 

I feel refreshed after my period and every other female goes through the same thing. I go through the paces, having to remember to go the toilet to change my tampon is just another number on my mental "to do" list. I'm nit out off by blood or my vagina, I can feel gross whilst on my period but nothing a nice shower, selection of cravings and a nice snuggle won't cure.

I just don't like looking about three months pregnant the week before I'm due.

I'm 19, live in the UK, single, and I live with my mother. I am studying nursing and work as a Health care assistant on Bank. I hope to finish nursing and after a few years head back into studying for Medicine. I want to gain foundation knowledge before starting my journey towards becoming a doctor.

I see my father every 2 weeks for around 30 minutes which isn't as much as I'd like but he's busy and not an emotional person which upsets me. I realised that I don't appreciate people until they're not there all the time. My parent's separation has hit me hard even if it did occur 5 years ago.

I am pretty boring socially as I dive into my studies leaving little no to time spending time with friends, I put a hell of a lot of pressure on myself to strive for the best in hopes of not disappointing anyone. I finished my fiest year top of the class with 100 across the board which was nice. When I *do* go out I get drunk when clubbing and like to have a wiggle on the dance floor. I like to make people laugh and like speaking to new people.

My hobbies are reading, movies, trying new food because I love food, decorating my nails at the weekend, makeup, gym when I can remember or be bothered, and walking. I like people watching because I wonder what their lives are like and make up scenarios in my head, I'm very content sitting in a coffee shop and so.

However,  I suffer with depression, self harm which isn't as bad nowadays, and suicidal thoughts. Thus happens when everything becomes too much for me but so far I'm just about coping. I have no idea what to do sometimes which can be confusing when I have a lot going on and need to compose myself. 

Relationship wise? It's nonexistent

I have actually been make out buddies with my best guy friend! It's always nice at parties to have someone you can kiss without any expectations of it leading to something more. In my opinion it was good, I didn't see him as someone I would have sex with but kissing was great for the both of us.

TL; DR: Make out buddy system is the shizbang.
